_comment: A source archive whose package.json declares a ranged dependency and no `scripts`, and commits no lock. In a SOURCE submission a package.json is always a build manifest - only an XPI-only submission may use one to declare vendored libraries - so the absent `scripts` block buys nothing and sca-lock-file-missing rejects it. The two XPI lock checks stay silent: both are sca:false, because a range is legitimate here and the lock is what must pin it. sca-lock-file-invalid has no lock to read. The shipped background.js is packed so the archive is not redundant. The XPI here also ships a package.json of its own, which in a source-code submission belongs in the archive - the copy the reviewer reads and the build installs from - so sca-not-required warns that this did not need to be a source submission. It is advice about the NEXT one and narrows nothing here.
